content.text:
I took the second seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin, and the quest "The Vault's Stone" is complete. I didn't need to fight, sneak or turn the dead. The Warden had nothing to say to me. The Unbound Rearguard and the Restless Dead did not stop me when I went to the stone and took it.

The Tablet of the Kings beside the stone says the Eye, if lifted, parts every tree from every other. If it is used where it sits, it strengthens them. I never ran a separate "read" command on the tablet. The journal entry already gave its contents when the quest closed.

I now carry two of the three stones, the one from Blackrose and this one. The third is in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, reached by boat near Noota Nara. All three go into the gate at Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.

These questions are still open:
- Why the Unbound drain the seal trees.
- What moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and where its key is.
- How Nesh-Deeka knows so much about the Unbound.

The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is still hunting the same relics. The game has accepted my final notes and ended.
